LanguageData.CR_Highstorm_Warning_Message: The windspren have gone still. A highstorm approaches from the east and will strike within the day. Ensure all colonists and livestock are sheltered behind solid walls.
LanguageData.CR_Highstorm_Alert_Explanation: A highstorm approaches from the east. All buildings must have solid walls or doors on their eastern side to provide shelter. Those caught in the open risk death.
LanguageData.CR_Weeping_Start_Message: A steady, gentle rain has settled over the land. The Weeping has begun. For the coming weeks, the skies will weep softly, but no highstorms will come.
LanguageData.CR_Weeping_End_Message: The constant rain has lifted. The Weeping has passed, and with it, the reprieve. The highstorms will return.
LanguageData.CRO_EyesOfLight_Text: As Stormlight courses through {PAWN}'s veins, their eyes lighten. {PAWN_pronoun} is darkeyes no longer.
LanguageData.CS_Savant_Surgebinding_Stage1_Message: {PAWN} has used the Surge of {POWER} so frequently that Stormlight flows through that surge more naturally. The connection to {POWER} deepens.
LanguageData.CS_Savant_Surgebinding_Stage2_Message: {PAWN}'s spiritweb has been reshaped by the Surge of {POWER}. The surge answers with greater force, but the bond has become a chain.
LanguageData.CS_Savant_Surgebinding_Stage3_Message: {PAWN} has drawn so deeply on the Surge of {POWER} that it has permanently scarred {PAWN_possessive} spiritweb. The surge's power is transcendent, but it has left permanent marks on body and soul.
